shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && cat next.config.ts && echo "--- app tree:" && find app -type f | head -50

grep -rn "connection()" 01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -20; echo "=== deprecated mentions ==="; grep -rn "deprecat" 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/io.md
cd /workspace && node -e "import('next/server').then(m=>console.log('connection:', typeof m.connection)); import('next/cache').then(m=>console.log('io:', typeof m.io))" 2>&1 | head

grep -o "connection" node_modules/next/server.js | head -3; echo "--- server.d.ts:"; grep -rn "connection" node_modules/next/types/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- io in next/cache:"; grep -o "\bio\b" node_modules/next/cache.js | head -3; cat node_modules/next/cache.js | head -20
cat app/page.tsx && echo "=== layout ===" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json

(timeout 90 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:3111 -o /dev/null && break; done
echo "=== request 1 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^>]*>[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "=== request 2 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^>]*>[^<]*</time>'
sleep 2
echo "=== request 3 ==="; curl -s http://localhost:3111 | grep -o '<time[^>]*>[^<]*</time>'
pkill -f "next start -p 3111" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo done
